item.title: Understanding Variable Assignment in Common Lisp: A Practical Guide
item.description: Learn how variable assignment works in Common Lisp, including global and local variables, setq, let, and defvar. This practical guide covers key differences from modern languages and best practices for efficient Lisp programming.
